Team Expense Policy

Last modified: Sep 12, 2025 by Alex Torres

This policy covers reimbursable expenses for all Engineering and Product team members.

Mileage rate: $0.58 per mile

Per diem (travel): $65/day

Home office stipend: Up to $400/year

All receipts must be submitted within 30 days via the Concur portal.
